verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਮਵਾਸ ਸਾਧਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਆਨਿ ਤਾ ਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਰਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau kouoo mavaas saadh bhoomeeaa milaavai aan taa par prasa(n)n hot nirakh nari(n)dh jee ||

en.bdb: If a brave warrior defeats a rebel landlord and brings him into the protection of the king, the king rewards him out of happiness and glory is bestowed upon him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਪੈ ਜਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਹੀ ਰਜਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jau kouoo nirapat bhirat bhaag bhoomeeaa pai jai dhai maare bhoomeeaa sahit hee raji(n)dh jee ||

en.bdb: But if an employee of the king absconds the king and joins the rebel landlord, the king launches a campaign against him and kills both the rebel landlord as well as the disloyal servant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਰੇਸ਼ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਤ ਨਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: aan ko sevak raaj dhuaar jai sobhaa paavai sevak naresh aan dhuaar jaat ni(n)dh jee ||

en.bdb: If someone's employee takes refuge of the king, he earns praise there. But if a servant of the king goes to someone, he earns slander from all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਅਨਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥੪੬੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh aan anat saran gur aan na samarath gursikh prat bi(n)dh jee ||464||

en.bdb: Similarly, if a devotee of some god/goddess comes to the True Guru as a devoted disciple, the True Guru bless him with His refuge, initiates him in the meditation of His name. But no god or goddess is capable of granting refuge to any devoted Sikh of the True Guru.  (464)
